repeated: every rejected nested begin leaves poison true, repeated healthy refusals/reason retained; final close/reopen clears poison
resetAfterPoison: inactive begin explicitly clears old poison; separate episode can be poisoned again; third clean reopen
differentCase: distinct shared case states on same batch; poison one does not affect healthy second; both close/reopen
differentBatch: separate case and batch states; poison one does not affect second; zero assertions cover both live/cumulative ledgers
